verdict.rationale: Tilled documents per-merchant dispute management: merchants manage disputes through the Dashboard, and a Disputes API supports building a custom dispute experience. That covers the dashboard/API surface and implies disputes are scoped to each merchant. Evidence submission and automatic posting of outcomes to seller balances are not documented. missing for 10: explicit evidence-submission workflow via API/dashboard, documentation that chargebacks are attributed to the correct sub-merchant, automatic flow of dispute outcomes into seller balances/payouts, independent corroboration

support.subject: As an ops user, disputes are managed per seller — chargebacks land against the right sub-merchant, evidence is submitted via API or dashboard, and outcomes flow back into seller balances automatically

citations.quote: Merchants can manage disputes through the Dashboard.
a custom dispute management experience can be built using the DisputesAPI.
